name: Prop_PlasticCentroidCpy
formula: =LAMBDA(vertices,totalArea,maxX,minX,maxY,minY,LET(cNA, (maxY + minY) / 2, shapesArr, {ref}SplitPolyByLine(vertices, minX, cNA, maxX, cNA), upperArea, REDUCE(0, shapesArr, LAMBDA(acc,shapeText, LET(shape, VALUE(DROP({ref}TextToArray(shapeText), , -1)), Cy, {ref}Prop_Cy(shape), IF(Cy > cNA, acc + {ref}Prop_Area(shape), acc)))), areaDiff, upperArea - totalArea / 2, IF(ABS(areaDiff / (totalArea / 2)) < 0.0001, cNA, IF(areaDiff < 0, Prop_PlasticCentroidCpy(vertices, totalArea, maxX, minX, cNA, minY), Prop_PlasticCentroidCpy(vertices, totalArea, maxX, minX, maxY, cNA)))))
comment: Find the y-coordinate of plastic centroid of a polygon bending about x axis (axial force = 0). Last update at 2024-07-02.
